items.summary: Recommendation: reject new production, financial, credential, configuration, spending, and high-priority queue work. Existing reversible SEO and measurement work should continue to its stated gates; no outcomes are proven, and aggregate affiliate income cannot be assigned to individual sites. Preserve only bounded public research for the remaining evidence gaps and require measurable before/after results before approving additional implementation.
